commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+7' The ball falls to Adrian Nino (Atl. Madrid) on the edge of the box, but his shot goes well wide of the goal.
90+5' The resulting set piece from Atl. Madrid is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+2' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) misses the penalty. His shot goes just wide of the right post.
90' Yvan Neyou (Leganes) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
90' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is going to take the penalty!
89' It’s a PENALTY to Atl. Madrid after the VAR review!

88' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Atl. Madrid.
87' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner with a short pass.
85' We are about to witness a substitution. Diego Garcia (Leganes) is replacing Miguel de la Fuente.
84' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 9:13.
82' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marko Dmitrovic intercepts the ball.
81' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the left post.
80' Borja Jimenez has decided to make a change. Roberto Lopez (Leganes) replaces Dani Raba.
79' Substitution. Javi Galan did his best and is replaced by Adrian Nino (Atl. Madrid).
79' The corner is swung in but Atl. Madrid can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
78' Half-chance! Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) plays a pass into the box, but Marko Dmitrovic reacts well to snuff out the attack.
75' The corner from Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is intercepted by the defence.
74' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
73' Chance! Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
73' Dani Raba (Leganes) receives the ball inside the box from the resulting free kick, but fails to score as his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
72' Here's the change. Renato Tapia leaves the pitch and Jorge Saenz de Miera Colmeiro (Leganes) comes on as a substitute.
70' A dangerous free kick that is situated just outside the box will be taken by Dani Raba (Leganes) who is well-known for his brilliant shooting technique.
70' Renato Tapia (Leganes) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
70' Mario Melero shows a yellow card to Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) for his blatant foul.
70' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
69' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
67' My Gran could have done better! Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post.
67' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
65' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) sends a chip pass into the box, but Marko Dmitrovic is quickest to intercept the ball.
65' The manager makes a subsitution with Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) coming on for Giuliano Simeone.
64' Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the roof of the net and forces a good save out of Marko Dmitrovic.
63' Seydouba Cisse (Leganes) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
62' A lofted cross from Koke (Atl. Madrid) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
60' Substitution. Nahuel Molina makes his way off the pitch and Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) comes on as his replacement.
60' Here is a change. Pablo Barrios is going off and Diego Simeone gives the last tactical orders to Koke (Atl. Madrid).
60' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
59' Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) picks up a long through ball, but Jan Oblak deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
59' The attendance for today's match is 12371.
57' The free kick is taken by Dani Raba (Leganes), but ball is cleared.
57' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) was quite harsh and Mario Melero didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
54' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid), who fires in a direct effort inches over the crossbar. What a chance!

53' It seems like Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is about to take a free kick. The goalkeeper has to be alert and careful how to position the defensive wall. This is the perfect distance for a direct shot.
53' Mario Melero interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Renato Tapia (Leganes).

49' 1 - 0 Matija Nastasic (Leganes) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Dani Raba. His header bounced off the ground and went inside the right post behind the goalkeeper. It's 1:0.
49' Dani Raba (Leganes) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
49' Juan Cruz (Leganes) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
48' Leganes can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) comes off for Samuel Lino.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Borja Jimenez probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Javi Hernandez (Leganes). He is replaced by Darko Brasanac.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) has tested the patience of referee Mario Melero and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
43' The Atl. Madrid players are exchanging some short passes and control the game at the moment, but one of the defending players steps in and intercepts the ball.

42' Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
39' Juan Cruz (Leganes) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
38' Juan Cruz (Leganes) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
37' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but Marko Dmitrovic comes off his line to gather the ball.
36' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) steps up to take a free kick and sends it in, but the opposition's defence is alert and clears the ball to safety.
35' Mario Melero has a clear sight and sees a foul from Javi Hernandez (Leganes).
34' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
32' Juan Cruz (Leganes) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the bottom left corner is far too weak and Jan Oblak makes a simple save.
30' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
29' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Atl. Madrid comes to nothing.
28' Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
27' Atl. Madrid failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
26' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the bottom right corner, but Marko Dmitrovic keeps it out with an amazing save.
26' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball only rattles the right post.
25' Juan Cruz (Leganes) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
24' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
23' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) jumps into a tackle and Mario Melero signals a foul.
21' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker over the crossbar.

18' What a wasted opportunity by Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom left corner, but Jan Oblak makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
17' A crossfield pass from Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) fails to find any of his teammates.
15' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

14' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Marko Dmitrovic pulls off a brilliant save.
13' Leganes are ruled offside.
12' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) controls a pass, goes past a defender and curls a shot from the edge of the box right onto the crossbar.
9' Half-chance! Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) plays a pass into the box, but Marko Dmitrovic reacts well to snuff out the attack.
9' The cross into the penalty area from Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
8' Mario Melero blows his whistle and it's Sergio Gonzalez Poirrier (Leganes) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
7' Atl. Madrid keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
5' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
3' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range, but his poor effort sails high over the bar.
1' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Juan Cruz (Leganes), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Leganes will kick-off.
Mario Melero will referee today's match.
